title: Angry Owens gives Mishlove a sore throat over the phone

tellings.quote: He got angry and within minutes I could feel this sensation in my throat
I think he was on the phone with him and he all of a sudden, you know, like stopped being able to breathe or something
tellings.difference: Told secondhand as Mishlove being unable to breathe, rather than a sore throat after Owens grew angry.
tellings.link_reason: The same incident: Owens physically affects Mishlove during a phone call.

as_told.title: Mishlove struggles to breathe while on the phone with Ted Owens

plain: Ted Owens, a man said to have mind-over-matter powers, once got angry on the phone and made the other man's throat hurt. That is what the researcher Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels, and he says he was the man on the other end of the call, in 1976. In his words, Owens "got angry and within minutes I could feel this sensation in my throat." If that is true, a person could hurt someone far away just by wanting to. Michels tells the story again in a later episode, citing a book about Owens called The PK Man, PK being short for psychokinesis, moving things with the mind. His version is different: Mishlove suddenly "stopped being able to breathe or something" while they were on the phone.
